author_relation: New leaf-helper nonauthor. Prior related directory-helper source reviewer and CI-script author; nonblind development source review, not protected/blind evaluation or recovery proof.

findings.problem: tiny uses t.TempDir directly, while hashFile/openRead/noSymlink reject symlink ancestors. Common Darwin /var or /tmp aliases can reject fixtures before the intended controls.
findings.minimum_patch: Use filepath.EvalSymlinks(t.TempDir()), propagate its error, and construct all fake paths from that canonical root. Production no-symlink guard must remain unchanged.
findings.science_effect: owned fake path setup only; no source selection, safety, budget, labels, model or original API changes

verified_by_source: Build targets Darwin/Linux only. Exact Go1.27.1 module proposal; no compiler success is claimed.
Strict typed canonical JSON uses MarshalIndent plus LF and reencoding equality. Config external SHA is validated before output; unknown/duplicate/alias fields reject.

Selection is explicit,1..8 completed_owned_record leaves, no automatic names or discovery. Raw<=1MiB and configured gzip<=512KiB. Device/inode are canonical uint64 decimal strings, mtime_ns canonical int64 decimal, nlink exactly1, plain canonical owner-rw modes only.

Paths are clean absolute, bounded, without NUL/CR/LF or symlink ancestors. Restore is a fresh source sibling; output is fresh beneath Root. Protected pins cannot overlap source/restore/output; selected inode identities and casefolded source/restore paths are unique. Physical protected-pin aliases reject.

All source files are full byte/SHA/size/mode/device/inode/nlink/mtime checked before output. openRead uses O_NOFOLLOW and SameFile; hashFile verifies metadata after reading. Pack checks source before/during/after compression.
Gzip output is O_EXCL0600, sticky bounded writer, mandatory successful Close/file Sync/parent Sync. Failure preserves the partial archive and does not append a deferred gzip footer.

Restore is a real O_EXCL sibling file. Its exact raw limit probes through genuine gzip EOF, checking CRC and ISIZE. Multistream(false) with buffered ByteReader and a trailing-byte probe rejects extra bytes or members.

Restored bytes/SHA and plain mode are checked and successful file/parent Sync returns before COMMIT. Fresh restore physical metadata is pinned. Original mtime remains exact in COMMIT; it is not physically reapplied to the temporary restore, matching the documented bytes/SHA/mode equivalence claim.

Durable COMMIT file Sync plus parent Sync precede original unlink. Config/selection/admission/prior-account/COMMIT pins and exact archive/restore/original physical pins are rechecked, followed by final original stat and no-symlink guard.

Original unlink returns and parent Sync returns before restore cleanup. Restore cleanup requires its exact captured byte/physical pin; no RemoveAll. Both original and restore absence plus cleanup parent Sync precede durable CLEANUP-ACK. Only ACK completion increments completed leaves and starts the next leaf.

First failure stops later leaves; partial files, archives and COMMIT remain. No retry or automatic resume. Failure gives complete=false, reclaim=null and no FINAL authority. States distinguish original unlink returned from parent Sync returned; JSON row presence alone is not durability proof.
Controls charge their full encoded size before creation and enforce one128KiB budget across all leaves, reserving2KiB stdout. Even a failed partial write is conservatively charged.

Every prospective phase checks current + prior gzip caps - prior removed raw bytes + this actual selected raw restore size + this gzip cap + full128KiB controls <=512MiB. Prior subtraction is valid only after prior cleanup ACK; every phase is prechecked before output.

Final reclaim lower bound is sum(selected original bytes - actual retained archive bytes) - full128KiB controls. It is a logical-path byte bound, not filesystem-block or lifetime-write saving. Negative lower bounds remain possible and are not inflated.

Synthetic source has12 top-level tests and6 subtests. It includes re-pinned truncated/CRC/trailing/second-member cases, empty restore, source/binding/mtime drift, COMMIT Sync failure, postunlink Sync failure, stop-next-leaf, hard/symlink and exact-cap rejection. They have not been run by reviewers.
limits_and_Root_requirements: Root classification, rights, exact selected current membership and quiescent writers remain prerequisites; no hostile concurrent replacement guarantee is claimed.

Census/prior-account/helper source pins are checked at admission. Their meaning and actual executing source/tool/compiler mapping are external Root responsibilities. All metadata reads share32KiB cap; eventual census/account/config/selection/admission/helper files must fit.

Full1MiB raw +512KiB gzip +128KiB controls adds1703936 B and exceeds the latest roughly1.4MB reported head. Smaller concrete raw/caps and all prep/review/materialization/tool/log costs require refreshed Root census and explicit admission. No encoded-fit estimate or approval was created.
Null archive/result fields on failure do not exempt retained partial bytes from the successor census. Existing archives/accounts and the enclosing retained Root scope remain unchanged.
No selected payloads or previous archives were read/hashed; no full compiler/source closure or actual restore/unlink was exercised.
